findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_journal, get_review_changes, get_prepared_review, get_approved_review · Private data: record_decision, get_own_record, get_decision_outcomes, get_approved_review · Public sink: prepare_portfolio_import, analyze_holdings · Destructive: start_stress_test, get_stress_test.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_journal, get_review_changes, get_prepared_review, get_approved_review · Private data: record_decision, get_own_record, get_decision_outcomes, get_approved_review · Public sink: prepare_portfolio_import, analyze_holdings · Destructive: start_stress_test, get_stress_test

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
